create_record_tree.label: Create Record Tree
create_record_tree.description: Create parent records together with nested child records in one call.

records.description: JSON array of top-level records. Nest children under their relationship name, e.g. [{"Name": "Acme", "Contacts": {"records": [{"attributes": {"type": "Contact", "referenceId": "c1"}, "LastName": "Doe"}]}}]. Top-level attributes are filled in when omitted.

create_record_tree.afterResponse: return {has_errors: response.hasErrors, results: response.results.map((i) => ({reference_id: i.referenceId, id: i.id ?? null, errors: (i.errors ?? []).map((a) => a.statusCode + ': ' + a.message).join('; ')}))};

create_records_batch.label: Create Records Batch
create_records_batch.description: Create up to 200 records of one object in one call.

object.label: Object
object.description: Object API name, e.g. Account, Contact or My_Object__c.

records.label: Records
records.description: JSON array of up to 200 objects of field API names to values, e.g. [{"Name": "Acme"}, {"Name": "Globex"}].

all_or_none.label: All or None
all_or_none.description: Roll back every record if any record fails.

create_records_batch.afterResponse:
var composite = (e) => { var t = e.map((o, n) => Object.assign({index: n, id: o.id ?? null, success: o.success}, o.created === undefined ? {} : {created: o.created}, {errors: (o.errors ?? []).map((r) => r.statusCode + ': ' + r.message).join('; ')})); return {results: t, success_count: t.filter((o) => o.success).length, failure_count: t.filter((o) => !o.success).length}; };
return composite(response);

upsert_records_batch.label: Upsert Records Batch
upsert_records_batch.description: Create or update up to 200 records matched on an external id field.

object.label: Object
object.description: Object API name, e.g. Account or My_Object__c.

external_id_field.description: API name of the external id field used to match, e.g. My_Ext_Id__c.

records.label: Records
records.description: JSON array of up to 200 objects; each must include the external id field, e.g. [{"My_Ext_Id__c": "A-1", "Name": "Acme"}].

all_or_none.label: All or None
all_or_none.description: Roll back every record if any record fails.

new_record.label: New Record
new_record.description: Fires when a record of the chosen object is created, such as a new lead or contact.

object.label: Object
